title: Second missionary journey
description: The second missionary journey (Acts 15:40). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 51 AD (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: CONFLICT: Jones prints AM 4055 and AD 51. Appendix F also prints AM 4004 as 1 AD. A derived check (not stored): 4055 minus 4003 = 52, which is not the printed AD 51. Both printed figures are stored as printed (first-printed rule). Neither was adjusted. The sort uses the printed AD year.
